messages:
Emily: FYI customer FinBank reports model outputs abruptly truncating mid-stream; their webhook consumer fails when the JSON ends in the middle. They say this started after yesterday's model rollout. Requesting a hotfix — next scheduled release is ~2w out. Can we triage?
Alex: Adding to triage. Sounds P1 if customer is blocked. Need repro steps, impact matrix, and a suggested fix before greenlighting a hotfix. @Priya can you take a look?
Priya: On it. Quick read of their logs shows tokenizer prefixes >1024 tokens cause the KV lookups to be dropped and the stream returns partial sequences. Repro from their payload (sanitized):
```
prompt_prefix = '...'*1050
response = /v1/stream -> truncated JSON
```
I can try a defensive guard: detect oversized prefix in runtime and fallback to no-KV streaming for that request. Risk is small but needs QA. Rough ETA 6-8h dev + 2-4h QA.
Ben: If that's accurate we can do a targeted hotfix. Proposal: branch hotfix/finbank-kv-guard, lightweight patch, canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 30m observation windows. Rollback path must be one-button.
Marta: SRE checklist: monitor inference_error_rate, stream_truncations, token_latency_p50/p95, and connection_retries. Temporary alert: if stream_truncations > 5x baseline OR inference_error_rate > 0.5% in canary, auto-roll back. KV/secret systems unaffected. Also request a feature-flag to toggle the KV guard per-model.
Sam: I'll own comms to FinBank (contact Jane). Offer them canary access and status updates every 2 hours. Need a short comms template and an expected timeline.
Alex: Decision: proceed with hotfix if Priya's patch is limited-scope and passes end-to-end streaming tests. Launch criteria: e2e streaming tests pass, no p95 latency regression >10%, canary stability for two consecutive windows. If we hit any of those, we revert and move to config-based mitigation.
Priya: Working on the PR now. Will add the model flag `kv_guard_enabled` and a fallback path. Deploy helper command I'll use: `./deploy canary --branch hotfix/finbank-kv-guard --percent 5 --monitor 30m`.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: id=c-202603, branch=hotfix/finbank-kv-guard, initial_percent=5, monitors=[inference_error_rate,stream_truncations,token_latency_p95].
Ben: I'll set up the manual approvals for scaling to 25% and 100% and own the rollback. Also will prepare the rollback runbook with exact commands.
Emily: Support created INC-8472 and linked the FinBank case. I'll post status updates there and copy any customer-facing notes. Assigning Alex + Ben for comms and Priya for the fix.
Marta: Add the temporary feature-flag in config service: `features.kv_guard_enabled = true` scoped to model-id. That lets us flip without code changes if something unexpected shows up. Also validate metrics export for the canary shard.
Priya: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4212 (WIP). CI running. If CI green, I can merge and we can trigger the canary. ETA ~3h to canary start.
Ben: Ok aiming for 14:00 UTC canary start. @Sam please get the comms draft into this thread before outreach. I'll be on call during rollout.
Sam: Draft comms: "Hi Jane — we found a streaming edge-case affecting some long-prefix requests. We plan a targeted hotfix with a staged canary. We'll give you access to the canary and update every 2 hours. Expected start: 14:00 UTC, expected completion if successful: ~3 hours." Will DM for approval.
Alex: Adding launch checklist: 1) PR merged & CI green 2) Canary metrics dashboard up 3) Alerts in PagerDuty configured 4) Customer comms sent 5) Rollback runbook ready. 
Marta: I'll prep the dashboard and add alert thresholds: stream_truncations > 5x baseline (15m window) OR inference_error_rate increase >0.5% (15m) triggers PD.
Priya: CI passed, merged to hotfix branch. Tagging the canary deploy window.
deploy-bot: Canary started (id=c-202603) -> 5% traffic. Monitoring window 30m.
Ben: Monitoring now. Early check after 10m: no increase in truncations, p95 latency +2%. Holding for full 30m.
Emily: Noted. Support will standby and prepare a brief summary for FinBank after the first window.
Sam: Sent the customer note and offered canary access. Jane confirmed she'll route some traffic for validation.
Ben: After 30m window looks stable. Scaling to 25% with same monitors.
Marta: All metrics steady. No PD alerts.
Priya: Thanks — leaving feature-flag in place for quick toggle. If anything odd, we'll flip `kv_guard_enabled=false` to revert the behavior without redeploy.
Ben: After 25% hold, we'll decide on full rollout. If OK, final step is 100% and close INC-8472 with customer notes and postmortem.
Alex: Great work team. Keep the thread updated with any anomalies.
